body: Restructure invariant. The pure moves keep what each unit does: the revive/adopt start prologue, with the strict-modes refusal before any write and before the log opens; the open/up refused() helper, with its CLI refusal --json shape and exit code; upped, with the viola up output; the pump's restart code, with the TUI passthrough, the pump_child error and the reap wait bound; and run's window and trust steps, with the window step's 5 s wait bound. The existing layers hold these, green with no test edited beyond a re-pointed path or name, and the refusal --json tests stay green unedited.
A moved unit's tests reach it only by a re-pointed path or name. No test assertion is rewritten, and a moved unit exposes no more than its callers need.
Each moved file and each remaining file must sit under the code audit's complexity ceiling and its 800-line size ceiling, measured the audit's own way.
run.rs is on the boot path, so its split is proved by the smoke trio as well as the layers.

Mutants nextest profile: the whole-verify test path4_a_stamp_failing_the_dialog_rows_leaves_dialogs_to_the_human moves by name into the verify class's kill (20 s x 4), along with any other test P3's census finds that runs a whole verify. The general 15 s limit is not raised, and the unmutated baseline must pass with no TIMEOUT.

The one announced mutation run: the root crate's 372 in-diff mutants from 15a566e8, run behind an announced stop that the overseer answers. It runs with --copy-target=false, -j 5 and a kill deadline, with TMPDIR set to a short-named scratch dir. It lands as an addendum recording a score with caught, missed, timeout and unviable counts. It is the mutation audit that covers invariants held in crate tests.

viola-pty restart-path survivors: one killing test per survivor class. The classes are the generation guard (which output copy ended) and the time limits in reap_within and drain, which bear on the switch's 10 s reap wait. Each test is red with its guard removed and green with it.
viola-state survivors: one killing test per survivor, starting with the ancestor-walk bound (chain.len() < max, the security plan's limit of 8 ancestor pids). Each has its remove-the-guard control.
r2-open.sh refuses before any start on a locked desktop and on a scratch dir that is not fresh. A check proves this without running the live arm, through a rehearsal or a stub of hyprctl.

The chunk's own boundary, binding its new tests and its run: no live start, no window opened, nothing dispatched to the compositor, no key sent, no real claude run, no live arm of any r*.sh, and nothing read from the operator's real ~/.claude* or ~/.viola. Live readings never gate.
Nothing beyond the nine carries. No viola-e2e or whole crate goes under mutation, the window code is not reworked, viola verify is not split, and the r*.sh scripts get no shared library.

each new test is free of flakes and gets no retries

The measure a split is read by: each moved and each remaining file under the code audit's complexity ceiling and its 800-line size row, by the audit's own measure, so its over_ceiling and over_800 rows no longer list those three.

Where a moved unit may live and what it exposes: inside the same crate and command tree, adding no new verb, flag, refusal code, event kind, output line or hint; the shared prologue and the one refused() keep both verbs' --json refusal shape byte for byte.
How a test reaches a moved unit: by its new path or name only; no assertion of a moved unit's output is rewritten.

The mutants nextest profile: the whole-verify test moves by name into the verify class's kill (20 s x 4), any other test that runs a whole verify found by P3's census moving with it, the general 15 s kill unchanged; the unmutated root-crate baseline passes with no TIMEOUT.

Moved code keeps how it is instrumented. Its lines go out only through the obs_event macro, with no raw tracing or print macros. Its spans keep static names, skip all arguments and use an explicit field allow-list. Steps that were uninstrumented (the window line, the window view restore, the trust-record write) stay uninstrumented, and the trust-record log line stays as it is.

The chunk adds no event value, detail code, log field, refusal word or flag. The closed event enum, the detail codes and the diagnostics schema stay as they are, so the shared prologue and the shared refused() emit exactly the lines and codes their callers emitted, strict-modes-failed and the exit-1 detail of up and open included.

A moved unit stays inside its own crate, in a module of the verb or pump it came from, and exposes no more than it did. The shared prologue and refused() are crate-internal functions both verbs call. A test reaches a moved unit only through its re-pointed path or name.

The measure for the splits is the audit's own: complexity over its ceiling and file size over 800 lines. Every moved file and every remaining file must fall under both, and the next audit's M1, M2 and M3 rows must stop listing the refused() pair, upped, the pump, and run.

The addendum records a mutation:viola score with caught, missed, timeout and unviable counts, held to the rule that obs code is mutation-tested like product code. Its outputs and diff stay local and are never uploaded.

viola-pty's nine restart-path survivors get one killing test per survivor class: the generation guard on which output copy ended, the reap_within time limit and the drain time limit. Each test is shown red with the guard removed and green with it. No mutation run proves them.

viola-state's three survivors get one killing test each with its remove-the-guard control. The ancestor-walk bound comes first: chain.len() < max, held to the security plan's limit of 8 ancestor pids.

How the chunk is proved: no live start, no window opened, nothing dispatched to the compositor, no key sent, no real claude run. Tests run against the fake agent and synthetic test homes, never the operator's real ~/.claude* or ~/.viola. A real-CLI verify never runs.

run's start is on the boot path, so after its window and trust steps move, the run start events and the start's process log lines keep their order: process-start, the trust-record line, the window line, process-exit.

body: The mutants nextest profile's kill lines: the whole-verify test and any other test that runs a whole viola verify move by name into the verify class's 20 s x 4 kill; the general 15 s kill is not raised, and every kill stays below cargo-mutants' own timeout.

The one mutation run: the root crate's in-diff mutants from the recorded base, copy-target off, its own target and a short scratch TMPDIR, a kill deadline, run once behind an announced stop; its verdict read by counts (caught, missed, timeout, unviable) and host-excluded mutants recorded as such; its output never uploaded and no test home kept.
The mutation gate's thresholds and run verdict that the addendum's score is read against, a baseline-test-failure no longer being the root crate's outcome.

Killing tests for the PTY pump's restart path: the generation guard deciding which output copy ended, and the reap_within and drain time limits; child exit read on the process handle, real openpty spawns, time limits driven through the injected clock rather than sleeps.
Killing tests for the liveness ancestor walk's bound, the security limit of 8 ancestor pids, and the other two viola-state survivors; process faults real, no mocked process table.
Each killing test owes a bounded remove-the-guard witness: red with the guard removed, green with it, a one-off control and no mutation run of its own.

The r2-open.sh refusal on a locked desktop (hyprctl locked) and on a scratch dir that is not fresh, read by a rehearsal or a real stub executable of hyprctl on a test PATH; the rehearsal reads the refusal's own effects and starts nothing.

The restructure's invariant: the revive/adopt start prologue with its strict-modes check before any log open, the open/up refused() helper with its --json refusal shape, upped, the pump's restart code, and run's window and trust steps (run after the bind) each do what they did; held by the whole test layers green with no test edited beyond a re-pointed path or name, and for run's boot path by the smoke trio.

The measure the split is read by: the audit's complexity ceiling and its over-800-lines size count, each moved and each remaining file under them; the duplication read no longer listing the refused() pair or the prologue copies.
Where a moved unit may live: a new module of its own crate declared in the module tree (no orphan module), exposing no more than its callers need and keeping sync crates free of tokio.
How tests reach a moved unit: inline unit tests move with it, integration tests keep reaching the public surface; an OS-gated case stays in its binary's root file.
The declared boot paths of the project read by the phase's boot-path check, run's start being one of them.

The chunk's tests and checks start no live wrapper, open no window, send no key, run no real claude and read nothing of the host's real claude sessions or viola home; every viola they start is tied to a test-owned home.

body_fields.convention: each new test function is named by the test-function naming rule and lives inline as a unit test or in a surface-prefixed integration binary, table cases in rstest
each new test creates its own private home and directories, seeds its own data and never hand-writes product state
each new test waits on logged events or a bounded wait, never on sleep, and is never retried or parked with ignore
each new test asserts literal oracles on observable behaviour, never a Debug string or fixture internals
each new test fakes time only through the injected clock seam and fakes external processes only as real stub executables
each new test counts toward the comprehensive coverage floors and passes the zero-flakiness budget under nextest

body: MCP server, tool, tools/list and MCP reply-screen contracts: no MCP surface is touched.
Hook dialog, decision-body, answer mapping and dialog hold rows: no dialog or hook behaviour changes.
Send confirmation, paste framing, wheel and release rows and the viola send contracts: nothing of send or the wheel is reached.
Wrapper channel JSON-RPC error codes, link and unlink methods and channel wait contracts: the channel is not changed.
viola list board and list --json contracts and the event-data key contracts: no list or event shape changes.
Fuzzing, fuzz corpus replay and property-test generator rows: no parser surface is added or changed.
Hook performance budgets, hyperfine invocation and perf CI job rows: no hook path is timed or changed.
Harness session record, boot, status, cleanup and supervisor contracts and pre-push detail codes: no harness command is changed.
Process log line fields, log event corr and log stream contracts: the chunk adds no log line.
CI artifact names, retention, secret-scan hit classes and junit copies: no CI artifact or workflow is changed.
Fake agent command-line options, receipts and turn-script contracts: no fake agent option is added.
Absences of a database, outbound HTTP, a browser suite, a deploy stage and Windows or macOS support: nothing of the chunk nears them.
